# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old in Volume 1, reaching 18 years old by Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v3 c1 P18](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0018)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student, later homemaker  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v3 c39 P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an attractive girl featuring dark eyes, dark glossy hair, and rosy cheeks. She has a plumper, shorter frame compared to Nell Harcourt, and considers herself to be chubby or a dumpling. She also possesses charming dimples on her cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v3 c33 P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010), [v3 c33 P14](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, pragmatic, and affectionate, though she laughs frequently and easily. She is deeply devoted to her friends, especially Nell, and exhibits a straightforward, realistic outlook on life. Despite her practical nature, she enjoys engaging in imaginative games, vows, and romantic stories.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c26 P18](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0018)_

## Traits

- Pragmatic  <sub>[v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001)</sub>
- Affectionate and loyal  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

## Abilities

- Singing  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- Crocheting and handiwork  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049)</sub>
- Styling clothes and hair  <sub>[v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v3 c33 P7](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a lifelong bosom friend to Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
- To marry Gideon Duckett and build a home

## History

Isolde grows up at Pear Hill in Brierley and becomes the closest companion and bosom friend of Nell Harcourt shortly after Nell's arrival at Grey Shutters. The two girls swear a solemn promise of eternal friendship over a path they pretend to be flowing water, creating playhouses and sharing books. During a visit to her house, Isolde unintentionally becomes intoxicated after drinking three glasses of Thirza's currant wine, which Nell misidentified as raspberry cordial, prompting her mother to temporarily forbid Isolde from playing with Nell. This decision is later reversed after Nell saves Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from croup. Isolde attends Brierley school alongside Nell, partaking in school activities, picnics, and a local concert performance. Later, when Nell accidentally falls through a roof while playing 'Elaine' in a flat-bottomed boat, Isolde helps rescue her. Though Isolde does not pursue higher education at Regent's or college, she maintains a close relationship with Nell through letters and visits. In her late teens, Isolde becomes courted by and engaged to Gideon Duckett, eventually marrying him in a home wedding at Pear Hill and giving birth to a son named Gideon.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P23](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0023), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P32](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0032), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c28 P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011), [v3 c39 P45](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0045)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Pembroke of Pear Hill  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Named by a schoolmaster who lodged at her parents' house  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>

## Quotes

> The act of swearing is remarkably evil, after all.  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> Nell, you are an unusual girl. I had previously been told that you were unusual. Even so, it seems to me that I am going to be very fond of you.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> Most certainly I shall; and no other intimate friend will ever be mine—it is not my desire to possess one. Loving anyone else as deeply as I love you is impossible for me.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
